title: OKYO Pharma to Participate in 2026 Jefferies Global Healthcare Conference in London

body_markdown:
London and New York, NY, November 12, 2026. OKYO Pharma Limited (Nasdaq:[OKYO](https://www.nasdaq.com/market-activity/stocks/okyo) ), a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company developing investigational therapies for the treatment of neuropathic corneal pain (NCP) and anterior segment eye diseases, today announced that it will participate at the 2026 Jefferies Global Healthcare Conference in London, United Kingdom taking place from November 16–19, 2026.


The Leadership team will be available for one-on-one investor meetings throughout the conference. Investors interested in arranging a meeting should contact their Jefferies representative.


**About OKYO** **Pharma**


OKYO Pharma Limited (Nasdaq: OKYO) is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company developing innovative therapies for the treatment of neuropathic corneal pain (NCP) and anterior segment eye diseases, with ordinary shares listed for trading on the Nasdaq Capital Market. Lead candidate, urcosimod for neuropathic corneal pain (NCP), recently announced first patients enrolled in Phase 3 NEPTUNE trial. For more information, please visit[www.okyopharma.com](http://www.okyopharma.com/) and follow us on[LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/okyo-pharma/?viewAsMember=true) .
